comment: No source is published. THE PUNCH KNOB'S DEFAULT IS OUTSIDE ITS OWN RANGE. Coin configures parameter 3 with a minimum of 0.3, a maximum of 0.6 and a default of 1.0; Rack does not clamp a default, so the knob comes up at 100% while its tooltip range reads 30% to 60%, and Initialise puts it back there. The punch term is used as an extra envelope level of one plus twice the remaining hold fraction times the punch, so at the default it starts the note three times over full scale and the output clips for the first part of the hold. Output 0 is configured by the count passed to config() but has no configOutput and no PortWidget, so it cannot be clicked or patched; it is a leftover of the layout shared with Blip and Hit. The oscillator is a plain 50% square wave with no pulse-width or waveform control, oversampled eight times. The panel prints TRIG twice, on the pitch-change output near the top and on the note input at the bottom. Panel lettering came from https://library.vcvrack.com/screenshots/400/DigitalAtavism/Coin.png; the plugin ships no panel SVG.
